+- Test migration in the same task (the suite must compile+pass at completion): DELETE PromptCacheTests decision/selectSlot/trim suites and their property tests (spec of deleted code); REWRITE PromptCacheResolveTests + PromptCacheSlotPoolTests assertions to chunk semantics — reuse is asserted by `tokensToFeed` shrinking to the post-chunk-boundary suffix (not instance identity); eviction API tests keep evictAll/remove/isolation coverage. PromptCacheConcurrencyTests: double-checkout tracking becomes distinct-instance assertions (trivially safe now — keep a store/resolve churn race test for actor bookkeeping).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria

+- [ ] MLXLanguageModel.swift diff is zero for this task (except if trimAndVerify call site changes)

+- [ ] Full unit target compiles and passes: `swift test --filter MLXFoundationModelsTests` — zero failures (pre-existing metallib end-crash excepted)

+- [ ] `swift test --filter 'PromptCache'` green
+
